p.title: AI publication let a current-sensitive count or magnitude through without evidence
p.symptom: A current-sensitive answer sentence such as '200일선 위 44개 종목이다.' or '외국인 순매수는 1,234억원이다.' was kept although no evidence bound its figure, the leak behind audit H104; with a leading '현재' the same sentence was dropped.
p.root_cause: hasCurrentNumericContent is a whitelist of units and keywords that omitted counts (개, 곳, 건, 명, 종목) and Korean magnitudes (조, 억, 만).
p.fix: Counts and magnitudes are covered; 개월 and 개년 are excluded so a period is not read as a figure.
p.violated_rule: A figure in a current-sensitive answer must be bound to evidence or removed.
p.prevention: ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check P1525 assertions for the leaks, the periods that must not be flagged and the fallback strip; the mutation that removes the new unit list fails two of them.
p.verification: The AI contract, evidence, quote-evidence, chat-integration, premise and ESM core checks pass. Not verified: real model answers; a numeric claim in a non-current text claim is still not checked (policy decision).

changelog: **AI 공개 정책의 현재성 수치 판정 확장 (P{P}):** 개수(개·곳·건·명·종목)와 금액 규모(조·억·만)가 근거 없이 현재 수치로 통과하던 문제를 수정(H104 계열). 3개월 같은 기간은 수치로 보지 않는다.
